- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1768-1776,1871-1874 | severity=high | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The final `skip reason=runner_lost` gate checks only RUNNER_LOST_RUN_COUNT > 0 and an empty SUMMARIES_FILE. It does not check that every reported run was classified as lost, so another run that added no summary (for example `jobs_fetch_failed`) has its real failure suppressed.
  WHY: This breaks the change's fail-open-towards-filing contract and drops the unresolved failure with no heal report. Reviewers rated it MAJOR; the mapping to high is mine, and the source severities did not disagree. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite also claims RUN_COUNT is never incremented, and no other reviewer says so.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1871-1874 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `skip reason=runner_lost` exit does not set VALIDATION_ROUTE_SKIP_REASON before `exit 0`, unlike its sibling skip exits.
  WHY: The `_validation_route_exit` EXIT trap then posts "unspecified" instead of "runner_lost" for kind=validation_failure, and no test covers that kind. Severity disagreement: four reviewers said MAJOR and openai_gpt-6-luna said NIT. I used the highest.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1871-1874 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runner_lost skip fires whenever at least one run was lost and no summaries were collected. A `jobs_fetch_failed` or `jobs_fetch_invalid` run at lines 1768-1787 adds no summary, so its failure is dropped.
  WHY: A run whose jobs could not be read is treated as an infrastructure failure, which breaks the "fails open towards filing" contract.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1871-1874 (trap at 1501-1523) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The skip exit never sets VALIDATION_ROUTE_SKIP_REASON, although the sibling exits at 1772, 1782, 1793 and 1879 do.
  WHY: For kind=validation_failure the trap posts "unspecified", and the new tests cover only kind=issue.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1807-1822. The lost-runner check ignores run_attempt, so a job that deterministically kills its runner is never reported. Fix: apply the check only when run_attempt is 1 or unset (about 4 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1871. Apply both fixes together: set VALIDATION_ROUTE_SKIP_REASON="runner_lost" and add the "every reported run was lost" guard (about 4 lines).

  WHY: "No summaries collected" is treated as "all runs lost", so a real failure is hidden under `WORKFLOW_HEAL skip reason=runner_lost`. The test covers only the single-run case.

  WHY: The tracking comment says "unspecified" while the log says "runner_lost", and the validation_failure path is untested.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1871. Guard the skip so it fires only when the count of runs reaching the runner_lost check equals RUNNER_LOST_RUN_COUNT (about 5 lines).
